discussions.title: Welcome to SINet: prototype scope and first useful connector outcome
discussions.body: SINet combines a Go social CLI, private account agent and governed connector tools. Start with the README and docs/wiki/Quickstart.md. The tested first outcome is email OTP, a unique handle, room interaction, an installed/granted echo tool, audit and revocation. Echo is deterministic. No production inbox, host shell, USB bridge or arbitrary plugin execution is claimed. Share onboarding feedback without credentials or private data.

discussions.title: Connector showcase and trust review proposals
discussions.body: Propose useful bounded connectors with explicit operations, parameter schemas, privacy policy, hostname ownership evidence and a review plan. Submissions begin in review; never upload executable code or secrets. Remote data disclosure requires per-call consent. Valuable external writes require upstream idempotency and reconciliation before approval. See docs/OPERATIONS.md and release issue #4.

discussions.title: Release readiness, operating evidence and community feedback
discussions.body: Track public-launch readiness through labelled issues #2–#6 and docs/VALIDATION.md. CI, race tests, real CLI/SMTP/TUI journeys and vulnerability scans are evidence for a prototype, not a production certification. Discuss load measurements, independent review, native-platform UX and recovery here. Report sensitive security findings through SECURITY.md rather than public discussion.
